description: The very first bill I introduced in the Legislature, HB 1427, would have allowed more seniors, disability retirees, and veterans to qualify for a property tax exemption or deferral. I’m very pleased to share, that the Legislature has passed a similar measure, SB 5186, which likewise expands eligibility for this program. Here’s the summary from … Continued
